description: 48 patches across Feeld, FolderSync, Hidrate Spark, Meetup, Met Office, Tinder, and X, plus universal PairIP license-check bypass, universal OneTrust consent-banner auto-reject, and universal MITM patches (trust user CAs + bypass OkHttp pinning). v1.4.0 adds 'Show age-restricted and sensitive media' for X 12.7.1-release.0: it clears the blurred cover over age-restricted posts (the 'verify your age' interstitial) as well as the ordinary sensitive-media cover, by forcing X's single media-visibility predicate to report no blur interstitial. Complements Piko's 'Show sensitive media', which leaves the age-verification variant in place. The older X patches remain pinned to 12.4.1 and default-off. Purchase-breaking Tinder paywall patches and the umbrellas are also default-off.
